notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch succeeded for every page (curl with a Chrome UA, HTTP 200 throughout, no bot wall). robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-* disallow and no blanket Disallow:/, so all tiers were permitted; tier (a) was sufficient so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: built from the union of (1) the department landing page https://www.marksandspencer.com/c/home-and-furniture's embedded __NEXT_DATA__ pageData promo-card links, (2) the category sitemap https://www.marksandspencer.com/sitemap/uk_sitemap_home-and-furniture.xml (147 URLs, the authoritative dept category tree), and (3) each candidate leaf page's own foundItData sub-nav block (read from that page's __NEXT_DATA__). The mega-menu cards and the sitemap agreed; foundItData on every leaf page only surfaced /fs5/ facet-filter or ?filter= query-filter links (colour/material/brand refinements), never a genuine additional category page, so no extra nodes were added from it. QTY: each page's __NEXT_DATA__ -> props.pageProps.serverSideGqlResponseFed.productPageData.search.results.totalItems (server-rendered into the initial HTML, present without JS execution). EXCLUDED (neither array): all /fs5/* and ?filter=* URLs (facet/filter results, not category pages); Furniture, Lighting, Kitchen & Dining (plates/bowls/cutlery/glassware/mugs/dinner-sets/serving-dishes/outdoor-dining/pots-and-pans/baking/kitchen-utensils/lunch-boxes/travel-mugs/dish-racks), Decorative Home Accessories (photo-frames/mirrors/home-fragrance/plant-pots/wall-art/vases/artificial-flowers/books), Nursery furniture/travel-systems/nursery-decor, Bedroom/Dining/Living-Room furniture incl. mattresses; Suitcases & Luggage (fashion/travel bags, not home storage, per storage.md Sec.6); Garden Accessories (a mixed promo bucket of throws/cushions/planters/solar-lights together - not a clean textile or storage category, excluded as a grouping-only landing page); Fabric Swatches (qty=1, a single order-a-swatch utility product, not a genuine browsable category); Home Essentials, Best Sellers, Our Top Picks, Interior Trends, Colour Trends, Room Ideas, University Essentials, Cosy Home, Autumn/Spring Decor, Just Arrived, Home Promotion, Home Styles, buying-guide/content pages - all curated/promotional collection or editorial pages, excluded per View-All/Collections rule. Bathroom>Bathroom Accessories was judged ambiguous (generic 'accessories' label, only 1 SKU which happens to be a storage shower caddy) and placed in storage_rows at LOW confidence rather than dropped, per storage.md Sec.42 ambiguity handling. Home Accessories>Storage (qty=17) mixes some decorative rattan/glass boxes-bowls-trays with genuine storage boxes, but the website itself names the node 'Storage' (breadcrumb Home Accessories > Storage), which storage.md Sec.42 ranks as the first ambiguity-resolution signal, so it was kept at HIGH confidence in storage_rows. Kitchenware is a shared grouping row emitted in both arrays (leads to Kitchen Textiles in textile_rows and Kitchen Storage in storage_rows); its other children (dish-racks, travel-mugs, baking, kitchen-utensils, lunch-boxes, pots-and-pans) are Kitchen & Dining and were dropped. No duplicate rows; no product-detail/search/View-All/Collection URLs recorded.

textile_rows.flag: Not explicitly named in textile.md Sec.3, but same fabric-shell+filling bedding construction as Duvets which is explicitly listed; included by analogy.

storage_rows.flag: Website explicitly names this node 'Storage' (breadcrumb Home Accessories > Storage) but listing mixes genuine storage boxes with some purely decorative rattan/glass bowls and trays; kept per site's own category label (storage.md Sec.42 priority order).
MANUAL REVIEW: thin, generically-named 'Bathroom Accessories' node (qty=1); the sole SKU is a storage shower caddy but the category label itself is not explicitly storage-named.
